However, in the end, Gu Fei still couldn’t escape the power of the plot, and took the heroine into an unmanned small warehouse.
Gu Fei shrank in the corner, shivering, waiting for death to come.
Who knows…that night, the heroine did not differentiate into an alpha, but become an omega.
Gu Fei smelled her pheromone in the air, and looked at the delicate girl in her arms and was shocked: This script is wrong!
【Tsundere fake and weak daughter A x Black bellied real and strong daughter O】

118507.synopsis:
Xi Yan transmigrated into a Western-fantasy power-trip novel—as one of the villains. She’s only eighteen, and very much a loli.
But she has a system.
At first, she thought it was one of those “be nice to the protagonist to survive” systems.
Turns out—nope. It’s a cold, emotionless Purity System. If she doesn’t bully the protagonist, she gets electrocuted.
Xi Yan: Fine.
But she doesn’t really have time to deal with the protagonist.
Why? Easy.
Hehe, not only did she transmigrate, she got a little baby as a bonus!
Even more unbelievable—right before her eyes, her once oddly cute little black blob of a child grows into…
Wait. Doesn’t she look a bit like that woman?
Xi Yan never imagined—when her baby was little, she had to feed her. And now that she’s grown… she still has to feed her.
———
Luo Lan knows she’s a commoner. Her admission into the aristocratic Magic Academy was only due to their fake pity.
She swore that once she got strong, she’d crush everyone who ever looked down on her—
Including Xi Yan · Fa Nuo.
Until one day, she opened her eyes… and saw Xi Yan asking her to call her “Mom.”
Luo Lan: ???
But all the resentment and hostility melted into overwhelming affection.
“Xi Yan, please keep watching me—until the end of time.”
associated_names: 反派萝莉妈妈，邪神女儿竟是女主

121067.synopsis:
Betrayal and death was that all her devotion to her husband had earned her?
“If I’m ever given another life, I will destroy you, Cedric Piaje.”
On the night before her execution, Illiana gripped the necklace around her neck and tore it off, driving it deep into her palm as she swore her vow.
And then, she returned to a fragrant day in May. Which is exactly one month before the wedding.
***
“I’m calling off the engagement.”
The empire was thrown into chaos. Cold stares and whispers followed her wherever she went. But if it meant she could have her revenge, she was willing to endure the scorn.
That was when he appeared.
“Revenge? I’ll help you whenever you wish to do it.”
She took his hand to survive because she was ready for whatever price this comes from.
“We’re married now, Illiana.”
His breath brushed against her skin, sinking into her like a blade. Even the act of breathing felt no longer hers to claim.
“So don’t even think of running away.”*
And at last, Illiana understood that this mas has no intention of letting her go.

121835.synopsis:
He is called the War Dragon of the Empire.
According to rumor, he has a ferocious face, body like a mountain, three heads and six arms, and must devour a million people a day just to be full.
Yet to the people of the Empire, he is praised as an angel fallen to earth, whose every action is a divine blessing for the ignorant masses.
The Star-Shattering Sword Saint, known for her peerless martial prowess, once publicly admitted he was the only one whose strength made her gasp in awe.
The famed strategic genius known as the kingdom’s top tactician even wrote in his biography:
“His intellect borders on the demonic. He’s the last person I ever want to face again.”
Brutal, kind, righteous, evil… countless titles and slanders swirl around him, making him the most controversial figure in the Empire’s history.
As for John Maslow, who mysteriously transmigrated into the game Empire’s Fall as a rookie commander—he only wants to take a bitter sip of wine and weep as he repeats his original dream:
“All I wanted was to properly command one losing battle… and then retire in peace and happiness.”
Why… why did things turn out like this?!
associated_names: 一心退休的我却成了帝国上将

122603.synopsis:
The eternal top trainee of Korea’s number one major entertainment agency.
So what?  
After six years of trainee life, all I had left was a failed college entrance exam score.
While preparing to retake the exam, a system window appeared one day.  
And its contents?
[Debut at Xso Entertainment, where there are no staff, no trainees, and no know-how!] 
“…”
Rejection is not an option.  
Fine, if I have to do it anyway, let’s do it properly.
associated_names: The Answer’s Set! Now Just Debut!

123627.synopsis:
Born as the daughter of the most noble being, yet destined to live the most tragic life—
Kartia Vistid.
A mere side character who ultimately meets her end at the hands of her father, the mad emperor.
She was a character in a novel—one I ended up possessing.In her first life, she tried to survive by aligning with the Duke of Evia.
In her second, she fled to a distant foreign land.
In her third, she became a rebel opposing the emperor.
Yet in every life, she was killed by someone else,
and each time she opened her eyes again, the cursed life repeated.So this time, she decided to change her fate—
If death is inevitable no matter what, she would become emperor herself.
She would take the hand of the very man destined to kill her—her father—
and enjoy everything as the sole heir to the throne.
But first, she needed to escape the tower where she was imprisoned.
“From now on, I’m not eating anything.”
Thus began the hunger strike of a timid, frail seven-year-old princess.
“You want to join the Imperial Knights but refuse to swear loyalty to the royal family? Then don’t. I’ll understand like a family member would.”
She gathers the heir of House Evia, who was her family, friend, and knight in her first life.
“Your brothers keep trying to kill you? Then how about coming to our empire as a hostage? At least your life will be safe.”
She looks after the foreign prince who had always been by her side in her second life.
“Let’s get engaged for now. You’re a righteous person, so you’ll spare me, right?”
She even goes so far as to get engaged to the male lead of the original novel—the man who was destined to kill the mad emperor.To rewrite her doomed future,
Kartia must move relentlessly in this bittersweet yet spirited story of conquering an empire. And—
“How could I not love you? But because I love you, I wish for your death.”
As the truth behind the emperor’s descent into madness and the secrets surrounding Kartia begin to unravel,
her resolve begins to change completely.

125419.synopsis:
One day, after enduring workplace bullying and finally snapping back before quitting, I ended up transmigrating into a novel I had been reading as a hobby.
And not just anyone, but Kang Haeyoung, an extra who, after being ostracized within his team, tries to take revenge by destroying the world, only to fail in the end.
I had already quit my job and had nothing left to do, so since I was here anyway, I decided to try living a happy life.
I got back at the Espers of Field Team 1 who used to bully him, and even stole away their guide, Shim Yeonwoo.
“Why are you being nice to me? Tell me what you want.”
All I did was give him a meal, yet he asks why I am treating him well.
“I learned it yesterday. How to guide.”
Just the other day, he was like a wary kitten, fur bristling with caution, and now suddenly he says he learned how to guide and starts initiating excessive contact.
In the end, he reaches out his hand first, saying we should get used to guiding… Was this really the right thing to do?
associated_names: 왕따 에스퍼가 되어버린 빙의자는 물 수 있습니다

129003.synopsis:
In the middle of the party, Zhu Jinyue had a falling-out with her boyfriend and stormed out of the venue. It was only after stepping outside that she remembered she had come in his car.
The venue was nestled in a secluded location, and the biting winter wind greeted her the moment she left.
Swallowing her pride and going back inside was out of the question. Calling a driver would mean waiting at least half an hour.
Just as she was feeling frustrated, a black Bentley pulled up nearby. The window rolled down, revealing a man in the driver’s seat with refined features and an elegant demeanor.
Zhu Jinyue remembered him sitting beside her boyfriend earlier. She had heard he was the founder of a recently booming tech company and a long-time friend of her boyfriend.
His gaze met hers, and his tone was gentle as he smiled and asked, “Heading down the mountain? Need a ride?”
Zhu Jinyue thought Shen Qinghuai seemed gentle and soft-spoken on the surface, but in reality, he was deep and inscrutable—impossible to read. He was like the moon in the clear, cold sky: visible, his light palpable, yet distant and untouchable.
That was until the night she caught her boyfriend kissing his ex-girlfriend—
As Zhu Jinyue stared coldly at the couple embracing in the courtyard below, Shen Qinghuai’s voice sounded beside her.
“Feel like getting back at him?”
His voice still sounded gentle.
“Use me. Treat me as a tool.”
“Do whatever you want.”
Back in high school, Zhu Jinyue and Shen Qinghuai had been classmates for a year—not too long, but not too short either.
When they met again, he was her boyfriend’s good friend.
The boy who used to wear faded T-shirts had transformed into the founder of a renowned company, dressed in an understated yet luxurious vicuña wool coat, exuding an air of refined elegance.
Zhu Jinyue had always thought Shen Qinghuai was like the moon in the sky. It was only later that she realized, to Shen Qinghuai, she was the one hanging high in the sky—the unattainable moon.
She had never looked back, so she never knew that someone had spent ten years traversing mountains and rivers, overcoming countless hardships, just to find his way back to her side.

143339.synopsis: The eldest son of a conglomerate family sees value.

147947.synopsis:
The person who should have loved her most selflessly, who carried her for nine months, gave birth to her, and named her Xin Gan (meaning Darling) that the whole world called her “darling,” abandoned her many years ago without hesitation, never looking back. After that, she lived in the Song family, with an ambiguous identity that brought shame upon the entire family, until she slept with Zheng Pianran.
She still had so many long years ahead of her, but she could no longer hope to find an ordinary, good man to entrust her life to.
Even after ten years of illicit affairs with him, in the most intimate moments, Xin Gan never considered marrying him.
Perhaps that’s not quite the right wording? It should be— even after ten years of illicit affairs with him, in the most intimate moments, Xin Gan never dared to think of marrying him.

158955.synopsis:
Good news: Lu Wu transmigrated to the cultivation world, where people can achieve immortality just by cultivating.
Bad news: Lu Wu is a good-for-nothing without a Spirit Root.

…

And her customers have evolved from just humans to a mix of humans and non-humans.
Human cultivators fight over her food, Demon Beasts offer her their unique treasures, and the Ghost Clan digs up their own graves for her.
As her business booms, Lu Wu, facing a provocateur, is about to show off her great powers. But before she can even make a move, her motley crew of customers directly crushes the enemy.
Humans, Beasts, and Ghosts: We will protect Boss Lu’s safety!
Lu Wu, who has unknowingly become a supreme expert: ??? Ah, life is as lonely as snow! By the way, what should I sell tomorrow…

189163.synopsis:
Iga reincarnated as an elf. After learning the name of the elf born on the same day as him, he realized he had transmigrated into a novel.
He had become a cannon fodder elf in a Western fantasy story.
In the original novel, the Mother Tree of Life was gradually withering away. He and the protagonist, Disia, were born on the same day, making them the only two naturally born elves in the Forest of Elves in the past five hundred years.
The protagonist Disia was born with maxed-out affinity for the wood element. According to the divine prophecy, he was the Holy Child destined to lead the elves back to their former glory and revive the Mother Tree. After his talent was discovered, the king immediately decided to keep him by his side for personal instruction.
Iga grew jealous of Disia’s talent and was manipulated by an evil mage into attempting to steal Disia’s gift through dark magic. In the end, however, he repented and used his life to stop the ritual, allowing his soul to return to the Mother Tree.
Iga, who had been an overworked corporate s*ave in his previous life, simply said: the greater the ability, the greater the responsibility.
As one of the only two natural elves born in the Forest of Elves in five hundred years, he was pretty rare too.
Although he wasn’t especially valued by the king, the elves in the royal city practically adored him. All kinds of artistic treasures were his for the taking. Since his talent was average, nobody placed expectations on him, nor did anyone pressure him to study!
Do whatever you want, learn whatever you want. No one would interfere. They would only praise him, “Baby’s little sprout has grown flower buds! Baby is amazing!”
For an overworked corporate s*ave, this was practically a dream paradise life!!!
Who would want to go against the protagonist? He couldn’t be bothered with something like that.
